name: SWE-ReX
summary: Runtime interface for coding agents to interact with persistent shell sessions across local and remote sandbox environments.
description: Install swe-rex from PyPI (1.4.0; Python 3.10+). Detects command completion and returns output/exit status, supports interactive command-line tools and multiple shell sessions. Separates agent logic from execution backends such as local hosts, Docker, Modal and AWS; extras include modal and fargate. MIT software; hosted infrastructure and model use are separate. It permits arbitrary commands in the configured environment, so isolation and permissions remain deployment responsibilities.

agent_access.notes: Local Python package: pip install swe-rex. Optional backend credentials and infrastructure are configured separately.
